title: Tensoring over a constant field sheaf commutes with cohomology
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], small relative to the universe of its module sheaves, let $\kappa$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $\kappa_{\mathcal C}$ be the constant sheaf of rings with value $\kappa$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $C^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of sheaves of $\kappa_{\mathcal C}$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and $N$ a sheaf of $\kappa_{\mathcal C}$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $C^\bullet\otimes_{\kappa_{\mathcal C}}N$ for the complex with terms $C^q\otimes_{\kappa_{\mathcal C}}N$ and differentials $d^q\otimes1$, the tensor product being that of sheaves of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and for a complex $D^\bullet$ of $\kappa_{\mathcal C}$-modules write $\mathcal H^i(D^\bullet)=\operatorname{Ker}(d^i)/\operatorname{Im}(d^{i-1})$, computed in the abelian category of sheaves of $\kappa_{\mathcal C}$-modules. Then for every integer $i$ there is an isomorphism of sheaves of $\kappa_{\mathcal C}$-modules
$$\mathcal H^i(C^\bullet)\otimes_{\kappa_{\mathcal C}}N\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\mathcal H^i(C^\bullet\otimes_{\kappa_{\mathcal C}}N),$$
natural in $C^\bullet$ and $N$, which on local sections sends $[z]\otimes y$ to $[z\otimes y]$.
